APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED: Someone else already decided this approval.
APPROVAL_EXPIRED: This approval timed out and was handled by the rule's timeout action.
APPROVAL_NOT_ASSIGNED: You aren't one of the approvers for this item.
APPROVAL_REASON_REQUIRED: Choose a reason for rejecting. Add a note if you choose Other.
APPROVAL_EDIT_NOT_ALLOWED: Only AI actions and flow steps can be edited before approving.
APPROVAL_NOT_QUICK_APPROVABLE: This item is above the quick-approve limits. Open it to review and decide.
APPROVAL_NOT_CANCELABLE: Only your own pending request can be withdrawn.
